g.text: Evaluation only: wired on staging against
the KWS *Test* environment, nothing in production
Service worker + IndexedDB for offline play.
no story reaches a child profile without
guardians author and submit, they do not approve).
("approved" is an action, not a resting state)
Three legs, three trust properties. The
parent's browser also returns to us with an
HMAC'd redirect, which carries no timestamp
and no nonce and is therefore replayable by
construction: that leg renders a result page
KWS is not a chosen mechanism yet (ADR-018 D1
is open); a verification against Epic's Test
environment is not a valid VPC.
Only the guardian's Supabase JWT touches
this box; the device grant and child
locally against their own HS256 secrets,
(the ONLY leg that writes consent state)
